Serverless Web Application Architectures 
PART 1: Formal Essay & Academic Technical Report 
1. Introduction & The Paradigm Shift 
The evolution of the cloud over the last two decades can be seen as a progression towards 
increasing levels of abstraction . Infrastructure as a service (IaaS) offered virtualization of storage 
and compute but the application developer was still responsible for operating system patching, 
capacity planning, and even maintenance of web servers. Platform as a service addressed some of 
these issues but the operational burden of provisioning and scaling policies still fell on the 
application developer. 
Serverless computing (often called FaaS – function-as-a-service) takes this trend to its logical 
endpoint. By developing applications as a collection of individual functions, the application 
developer does not have to worry about any of the underlying infrastructure concerns. The cloud 
provider is responsible for all aspects of function execution including
